headlines.title_en: Wall Street Breakfast | July 27, 2026
headlines.summary_en: International crude oil opened lower on Monday, with Brent crude falling over 7% at one point, breaking below $90, while Nasdaq futures rose over 1%. US-Iran mutual attacks paused: Iran's military said Sunday that the US halted strikes for two consecutive nights, and Iran suspended retaliatory strikes. Red Sea tensions escalate: Yemen's Houthi group attacked Saudi Red Sea port oil facilities twice in one day on Saturday, with Saudi airstrikes in response. Former CSRC Vice Chairman Fang Xinghai is under investigation. Wang Yi met with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi, stating China continues to support mediation efforts by Pakistan and others to resume dialogue and negotiations between parties as soon as possible, and properly handle the Hormuz Strait issue. China's Ministry of Commerce: 14 EU entities added to export control list. Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration: Individual residents' property placed in offshore trusts and trust income must pay personal income tax according to law. The Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate revised judicial interpretations to intensify punishment for insider trading and leaking inside information.

headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年原材料制造业利润快速增长
headlines.summary: 上半年，规模以上原材料制造业利润同比增长71.7%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.8个百分点。从行业看，在铜、铝等有色金属产品需求向好等因素推动下，有色行业利润增长99.4%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长4.7个百分点；在石油产业链条相关产品价格上涨推动下，石油加工行业同比扭亏为盈，化工行业利润增长67.8%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Raw materials manufacturing profits grew rapidly in the first half of the year.
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of the year, profits of raw materials manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 71.7% year-on-year, driving up the total profit growth of all industrial enterprises above designated size by 8.8 percentage points. By industry, driven by strong demand for non-ferrous metal products such as copper and aluminum, the non-ferrous metal industry's profit grew 99.4%, contributing 4.7 percentage points to total profit growth; driven by rising prices of oil-related products, the petroleum processing industry turned a loss into profit year-on-year, and the chemical industry's profit grew 67.8%.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: Shenzhen Component and ChiNext both up over 1%; ChangXin Memory Technologies sets multiple records in half a day of trading.
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data July 27: The market rose in early morning trading, with all three major A-share indexes turning positive. The ChiNext and Shenzhen Component each rose over 1%. At midday, the Shanghai Composite was up 0.4%, the Shenzhen Component up 1.41%, the ChiNext up 1.55%, and the Beijing Stock Exchange 50 up 1.88%. Half-day turnover in Shanghai and Shenzhen reached 1.35 trillion yuan, up 124.2B yuan from the previous trading day. Hot sectors rotated quickly, with nearly 4,900 stocks rising. Changxin Technology listed on the STAR Market, surging over 530% at one point, with a market cap of 3.61 trillion yuan, ranking first in A-shares, surpassing Intel's July 24 closing market cap of $465.6B (about 3.15 trillion yuan). Brain-computer interface sector opened high and rose, with Innovation Medical up 3 days in 2, and Aipeng Medical hitting the 20% daily limit; battery sector continued to rise, with Sacred Sun Power, Wanli Battery, etc.

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data July 27: Offshore CNY Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rates (CNH HIBOR) on Monday showed that major term rates mostly fell; overnight HIBOR dropped 8 bps to 1.20000%, hitting a new low since June 1. Additionally, nearly 30% of the HKMA's 30 billion yuan day-trip repo liquidity has been utilized. One-week HIBOR edged down to 1.40000%, hitting a low since June 8; two-week HIBOR rose to 1.45000%, and one-year HIBOR edged down to 1.68515%.

headlines.title_en: Noon market review on July 27: ChiNext index rises 1.55% in half-day trading, Changxin Technology becomes new A-share market cap leader
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite opened low and rebounded in morning trading, with the ChiNext performing strongly. Changxin Technology listed today, with its stock surging over 500% and half-day turnover of 122.1B yuan, becoming the first individual stock in A-share history to exceed 100B yuan in daily turnover, surpassing ICBC as the 'king' of A-share total market cap. Brain-computer interface concept stocks collectively surged, with Aipeng Medical, Nanjing Panda, Innovation Medical, etc., hitting daily limits. Battery industry chain lifted, with Sacred Sun Power, Longpan Technology, Wanli Battery hitting daily limits. Traditional Chinese medicine sector strengthened, with Longsheng Shenfa, Zhen Bao Dao, Yibai Pharmaceutical hitting daily limits. On the downside, oil and gas stocks adjusted collectively, with Zhongman Petroleum hitting the daily limit. Stocks showed broad gains, with over 4,900 stocks in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen markets rising, and half-day turnover of 1.36 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.4%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.41%, and the ChiNext rose 1.55%. 2. headlines.title: 国家统计局：上半年人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%
headlines.summary: 电子相关行业利润高速增长。上半年，人工智能与各领域加速融合，算力需求大幅增长，推动电子行业利润同比增长96.9%，拉动全部规模以上工业企业利润增长8.5个百分点，是规模以上工业企业利润较快增长的重要支撑。其中，服务器、高性能工作站相关领域中，计算机整机制造、计算机外围设备制造行业利润分别增长689.3%、305.8%；电子器件制造领域中，集成电路制造、半导体分立器件制造行业利润增长2579.5%、31.2%；电子元件及电子专用材料制造领域中，电子专用材料制造、电子电路制造行业利润增长209.7%、26.9%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: AI accelerated integration across sectors in H1, driving a surge in computing demand and boosting electronics industry profits by 96.9% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: Profits in electronics-related industries grew rapidly. In the first half of the year, accelerated integration of AI across sectors and surging demand for computing power drove the electronics industry's profit up 96.9% year-on-year, contributing 8.5 percentage points to total profit growth of all industrial enterprises above designated size, serving as a key support for rapid profit growth. Among them, in computer manufacturing and peripherals, profits for computer complete manufacturing and computer peripheral equipment manufacturing grew 689.3% and 305.8% respectively; in electronic device manufacturing, integrated circuit manufacturing and semiconductor discrete device manufacturing saw profit growth of 2579.5% and 31.2%; in electronic components and materials, electronic special material manufacturing and electronic circuit manufacturing profits grew 209.7% and 26.9%.

headlines.title_en: Multiple Beijing Stock Exchange firms disclose buyback plans; special loan tools broaden funding sources.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, share buybacks and shareholder stake increases among Beijing Stock Exchange-listed companies have notably heated up. According to incomplete statistics as of the evening of July 24, more than ten companies have disclosed share repurchase or major shareholder increase plans in July. From actual controllers, directors, supervisors, and senior management to shareholders holding over 5%, multiple parties have expressed intentions to increase holdings; from own funds to bank special loans, funding sources continue to broaden. (Shanghai Securities News)
